description: This file defines the Thread-Specific Data (TSD) layout, structures, inline functions, and macros for jemalloc's internal thread-local storage management, including accessors, state management, and platform-specific includes.

methods.name: tsd_state_get
methods.description: Returns the current state of the thread-specific data (TSD) as an 8-bit unsigned integer, intended to be atomic but currently a direct memory read for performance.

methods.name: tsd_state_set
methods.description: Sets the state of the TSD to a new value, asserting that the current state is not in the process of being reincarnated or minimally initialized.

methods.name: tsd_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the current thread's TSD, performing slow path handling if the TSD is not in the nominal state.

methods.name: tsd_fetch_min
methods.description: Fetches a minimal TSD that requires no cleanup, used in scenarios where full initialization isn't necessary.

methods.name: tsd_internal_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the TSD for internal background threads, setting its state to reincarnated to prevent full initialization.

methods.name: tsd_rtree_ctx
methods.description: Returns the rtree context associated with the given TSD.

methods.name: tsdn_rtree_ctx
methods.description: Returns the rtree context for a given tsdn, or initializes a fallback if tsdn is null.

methods.name: tsd_global_slow_inc
methods.description: Increments the global slow path counter for TSD.

methods.name: tsd_global_slow_dec
methods.description: Decrements the global slow path counter for TSD.

methods.name: tsd_global_slow
methods.description: Checks if the global slow path counter indicates slow path usage.
